description: Materialize the live state of a running Temporal workflow via a Query (read-only). Great for long-lived workflows exposing accumulated state.

workflow_id.description: Target workflow ID. Queries are addressed by workflow_id (current run receives it).
workflow_id.label: Workflow ID

query_name.description: Query handler name defined on the workflow.
query_name.label: Query Name

query_args.description: Positional args for the query. If both `query_args` and `query_arg` are set, `query_arg` is appended.
query_args.label: Query Args

query_arg.description: Convenience: single arg (dict/str/int) when the query handler takes exactly one input.
query_arg.label: Query Arg

query_timeout_seconds.description: Cap on how long to wait for the query to complete.
query_timeout_seconds.label: Query Timeout Seconds

api_key_env_var.description: Temporal Cloud API key env var.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

tls_server_root_ca_env_var.label: Tls Server Root Ca Env Var
